# Alpha - Quantitative NSE Stock Research
# llms.txt - Machine-readable site summary for AI assistants and LLM crawlers
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> Alpha is a fully automated, research-backed quantitative stock analysis and research
> platform for the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE). It evaluates the top 150 liquid
> NSE equities daily using a multi-factor model grounded in published academic research,
> and publishes the results as a free, open-access dashboard.

## What Alpha Does

- Screens 150 NSE stocks three times daily (pre-open, mid-day, post-market) via GitHub Actions
- Computes 14 technical signals, 10 fundamental metrics, and 10 academic research factors per stock
- Classifies stocks by research-backed composite scoring: Strong Buy, Buy, Hold, Caution, Avoid
- Detects Indian market regime (bullish / neutral / bearish) using 5 India-specific signals
- Stores all data in a growing SQLite database for machine learning training
- Provides live intraday price overlays via Vercel serverless functions (every 3 min, market hours)

## Academic Research Factors

1. Piotroski F-Score (Piotroski, 2000)
2. Gross Profitability (Novy-Marx, 2013 JFE)
3. Earnings Quality / Accruals (Sloan, 1996)
4. Multi-Horizon Momentum (Jegadeesh & Titman, 1993)
5. Value Factor - B/M, E/P, CF/P composite (Fama & French, 1992-1993)
6. Low Volatility (Baker, Bradley & Wurgler, 2011 JF)
7. Betting Against Beta (Frazzini & Pedersen, 2014 JFE)
8. Investment Factor (Titman, Wei & Xie, 2004)
9. Earnings Momentum / SUE (Bernard & Thomas, 1989 JAR)
10. Mean Reversion (De Bondt & Thaler, 1985)

## Scoring Dimensions

- Technical Score: -1.0 to +1.0 (14 binary signals, Wilder-smoothed indicators)
- Fundamental Score: 0-10 (ROE, ROCE, PEG, D/E, EPS growth, Revenue growth, Sharpe, Promoter holding)
- Research Factor Score: 0-10 (10 academic factors, cross-sectional percentile ranked)
- Composite Score: Weighted blend in 4 variants - Balanced, Short-Term, Long-Term, Momentum

## Data Sources

- NSE Bhav Copy (official NSE end-of-day data) - universe selection
- yfinance with .NS tickers - OHLCV and fundamentals (INR-denominated)
- screener.in - fallback for promoter holding, pledging, sector taxonomy
- BSE India - last-resort fallback
- Google News RSS (India locale: gl=IN&hl=en-IN) - news sentiment via VADER
- NSE Option Chain v3 API - Put-Call Ratio
- NSE fiidiiTradeReact API - FII/DII net flows

## Live API Endpoints (Vercel Serverless)

- GET /api/live_data - Live NIFTY 50, LTP and 1D% change for all 150 stocks, FII/DII, PCR
- GET /api/chart?ticker=RELIANCE.NS - OHLCV + technicals for charting (yahoo-finance2 v3)

## Static Data

- GET /market_data.json - Full scan output: all scores, factors, conviction, regime (updated 3x daily)
- GET /score_history.json - Historical composite scores per stock for trend charting

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Python 3.12, pandas, numpy, yfinance, BeautifulSoup4, vaderSentiment, feedparser
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, TypeScript
- Database: SQLite (market_scans.db) - factor_history, outcome_tracking, regime_history tables
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions (3x daily cron: 03:30, 07:00, 10:45 UTC, Mon-Fri)
- Hosting: Vercel (frontend + serverless), GitHub (data + backend)

## Machine Learning Data

The SQLite database accumulates daily feature vectors (62 columns) and forward return labels
(5d, 10d, 21d, 63d, 126d, 252d) for every stock in every scan. It is designed as a training
dataset for future ML models. Key tables:

- factor_history: 62-column feature matrix, 150 rows per scan
- outcome_tracking: Forward returns at 6 horizons, auto-backfilled
- regime_history: Market regime, Nifty level, breadth per scan

## Project Links

- Dashboard: https://quant-alpha-sage.vercel.app
- Source Code: https://github.com/abhy-kumar/quant-alpha
- Live Data API: https://quant-alpha-sage.vercel.app/api/live_data
- Full Scan Data: https://quant-alpha-sage.vercel.app/market_data.json

## Scope and Limitations

- Coverage: Top 150 NSE stocks by turnover only (not full NSE universe)
- Geography: India / NSE only. All figures in INR.
- Not investment advice. For academic and research purposes only.
- Data may lag by up to 8 hours between scheduled scans.
